title: DICOM CT scans show capillaries feeding eggs in a J-type

tellings.quote: You have great independent researchers like Gonzalo Chavez who helped set up tridactyls.org pointing out that the DICOM files made public, if you look at these CAT scans around even the J texts, the reptilians, you can see capillaries nourishing the eggs inside one of their bodies.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about small three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru, and the medical scans made of them. He says an independent researcher named Gonzalo Chavez, who helped set up a website called tridactyls.org, points to the public scan files, CT scans (3D X-ray images used in hospitals) saved in DICOM, a standard medical image format. Michels says that inside one of the bodies, a more reptile-looking type, you can see tiny blood vessels feeding eggs, which would suggest these were once living creatures.
